note: fw-manifest-join-01: reviewed joins between a DECLARED set and a WIRED set,
both keyed by name. scripts/check_manifest_join.py checks each in both
Why a manifest: a language-agnostic gate cannot know that 'Name:' in a Go
literal is a registry and 'case "x":' is a switch. That knowledge is
reviewed data here. A stale join (path gone, or zero names extracted) is a
FAILURE, never a skip - that is how the gates this framework replaced went
Origin: guardrail-mcp 2026-10-18 - seven registered MCP tools were absent
from the authorization action table, so every credential was refused while
tools/list still advertised them. The repo's own guard enumerated only what
a zero-value server exposed (39 of 61) and reported green over the gap.

joins.reason: Every collected test suite must carry a floor row, or it can shrink to zero silently: gen_floors only iterates rows that already exist, so a suite with no row is never compared to anything. This join is the missing half of fw-floor-01.
